cohort: The study included 150,345 pregnant individuals (3464 with COVID-19) with at least one completed trimester and 112,073 non-pregnant individuals (aged 15-45) with a positive COVID-19 test, all from the Canadian Mother-Child Cohort.
finding: Severe COVID-19 was more prevalent in pregnancy and was associated with higher risks of spontaneous abortions, gestational diabetes, prematurity, and NICU admission, though COVID-19 treatment with medications reduced these risks.
